productions.name: declaration
productions.syntax: declaration ::= record_type_decl | type_decl | error_decl | service_decl | function_decl | procedure_decl ;

productions.name: function_decl
productions.syntax: function_decl ::= [ async_marker ] "function" IDENT [ type_param_list ] "(" [ param_list ] ")" "returns" return_type [ contract_block ] "is" { stmt } "end" IDENT ;

productions.name: procedure_decl
productions.syntax: procedure_decl ::= [ async_marker ] "procedure" IDENT [ type_param_list ] "(" [ param_list ] ")" [ contract_block ] "is" { stmt } "end" IDENT ;

productions.name: stmt
productions.syntax: stmt ::= let_stmt | field_assign_stmt | assign_stmt | return_stmt | abort_stmt | if_stmt | while_stmt | case_stmt | scope_stmt | check_stmt | call_stmt ;

productions.name: while_stmt
productions.syntax: while_stmt ::= "while" expr invariant_clause { invariant_clause } [ variant_clause ] "do" loop_block "end" "while" ;

productions.name: equality
productions.syntax: equality ::= comparison | equality "=" comparison | equality "!=" comparison ;

productions.name: comparison
productions.syntax: comparison ::= sum | comparison "<" sum | comparison "<=" sum | comparison ">" sum | comparison ">=" sum ;

productions.name: sum
productions.syntax: sum ::= product | sum "+" product | sum "-" product ;

productions.name: product
productions.syntax: product ::= unary | product "*" unary | product "/" unary ;

productions.name: atom
productions.syntax: atom ::= STRING_LITERAL | DOUBLE_LITERAL | INTEGER_LITERAL | "true" | "false" | "success" | "failure" | "result" "." IDENT { "." IDENT } | "result" | "value" "." IDENT { "." IDENT } | "value" "[" expr "]" "." IDENT { "." IDENT } | "value" "[" expr "]" | "error" "." IDENT { "." IDENT } | "value" | "error" | array_literal | type_ref "{" named_arg_list "}" | field_path | IDENT "[" expr "]" | field_path type_arg_list "(" [ arg_list ] ")" | IDENT type_arg_list "(" [ arg_list ] ")" | qualified_name "(" [ arg_list ] ")" | IDENT | "(" expr ")" ;
